decisions.decision: Use the approved data-native hybrid language for all future interface glyphs: neutral or white structural stroke plus one customizable accent focal element.
decisions.rationale: This preserves modern visual character, makes active data/state legible, and supports one dashboard-wide accent token with derived light/dark variants.

decisions.decision: Apply iconography in three tiers: icon-only for universal reversible actions, icon plus short text for primary or ambiguous actions, and explicit text for confirmations and analytical choices.
decisions.rationale: Maximum word reduction without sacrificing moderator comprehension or misrepresenting consequences.

decisions.decision: Show currently implemented controls separately from future-only glyphs such as true rewind, fast-forward, reference-line actions, and continuous-scroll controls.
decisions.rationale: The current playback reducer only supports previous, next, seek, and tick; the atlas must not imply unsupported behavior.

decisions.decision: Keep semantic colors outside the customizable accent rule: destructive actions use danger red and selected multi-fullscreen panels retain selection green.
decisions.rationale: Safety and state meaning take precedence over decorative consistency.

decisions.decision: The final approved reset glyph is accent-color-editor-v11: a 7-degree clockwise adjustment, approximately 5.6 by 6.2 rendered pixels at a 21-pixel icon size.
decisions.rationale: The user visually approved its orientation, weight, and arc overlap as perfect.
